stories.title: Trump: “Mosca fornirà gasolio a Usa e mercato globale”. Zelensky: “Decisione disonesta”

en.title: Trump: "Moscow will supply diesel to US and global market". Zelensky: "Dishonest decision"
en.summary: The US president announced Russia would supply over 300,000 tonnes of diesel immediately, with additional quantities in November and subsequent months, expecting price decreases. The US has suspended sanctions on Russian diesel.

stories.title: Terremoto di magnitudo 7,6 a Panama, panico nella capitale

en.title: Magnitude 7.6 earthquake in Panama, panic in capital
en.summary: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake struck Panama with a possible tsunami alert issued by the US system.

stories.title: Terremoto di magnitudo 8 a Panama, panico nella capitale

en.title: Magnitude 8 earthquake in Panama, panic in capital
en.summary: The US Geological Survey reported an 8 magnitude earthquake that struck Panama, causing panic in the capital.

stories.title: Panama, scossa di magnitudo 7,6: allerta tsunami. Scene di panico nella capitale

en.title: Panama 7.6 magnitude earthquake: tsunami alert. Panic scenes in capital
en.summary: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit the Petaloza Arriba area with tsunami risks affecting multiple Central American and Mexican coasts. Airport operations were suspended and schools closed.

stories.title: Ranucci, il tribunale respinge il ricorso contro la Rai: niente reintegro alla conduzione di Report

en.title: Ranucci, court rejects appeal against RAI: no reinstatement to Report hosting
en.summary: A Rome labor court rejected journalist Ranucci's urgent appeal against RAI's decision to remove him from hosting the program. He had also received a ten-day suspension without pay.

stories.title: Il Nobel per la Pace a Navi Pillay, la voce del diritto che non piace a Trump e Netanyahu

en.title: Peace Nobel Prize to Navi Pillay, the voice of law disliked by Trump and Netanyahu
en.summary: An 85-year-old judge dedicated to international law and prosecuting war crimes from Rwanda to Gaza received the Nobel Peace Prize, provoking strong reactions from the USA and Israel.

stories.title: Ranucci, il tribunale respinge il ricorso contro la Rai: niente reintegro alla guida di Report

en.title: Ranucci, court rejects appeal against RAI: no reinstatement to Report leadership
en.summary: Rome's labor judge rejected the journalist's request for reinstatement after his removal from the investigative program in late August following a decade leading it. A disciplinary suspension of ten days was also imposed.

stories.title: Marsala dopo la doppia tromba marina: auto rovesciate, vetri in frantumi e detriti nelle strade

en.title: Marsala after double waterspout: overturned cars, shattered glass and debris in streets
en.summary: A violent tornado struck Marsala after two waterspouts formed offshore, causing extensive damage including overturned vehicles, damaged buildings, and debris. A school was evacuated with approximately 300 students, and multiple people were hospitalized.

stories.title: Premio Nobel per la Pace 2026 alla giudice Navi Pillay. Sanzioni Usa alla Cpi

en.title: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to judge Navi Pillay. US sanctions against ICC
en.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her courage and integrity against war crimes. Netanyahu and Trump criticized the award, with Netanyahu accusing her of promoting antisemitic demonization of Israel.

stories.title: La devastazione della doppia tromba marina a Marsala: auto ribaltate e feriti

en.title: Destruction caused by double waterspout in Marsala: overturned cars and injuries
en.summary: A double waterspout struck the port area of Marsala in Sicily, causing damage to buildings, vehicles and crops, with reported injuries.

stories.title: Nobel per la pace alla sudafricana Navi Pillay: “Genocidio a Gaza”. Israele: Goebbels applaudirebbe

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to South African Navi Pillay: "Genocide in Gaza". Israel: Goebbels would applaud
en.summary: The Nobel Peace Prize committee recognized Navi Pillay's role in ensuring war crimes and genocide are prosecuted internationally, triggering criticism from Israel and others.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia. Trump: “Dalla Russia 300mila tonnellate di gasolio agli Usa e al mondo”. Zelensky, “Putin ripagherà il diesel col terrore”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war. Trump: "Russia to supply 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to US and the world". Zelensky, "Putin will repay diesel with terror"
en.summary: Putin stated Russia would supply petroleum to the United States and the world. The UK announced 54 million pounds in aid for Kyiv as tensions continued between Ukrainian and Russian leadership.

stories.title: Equo compenso, il Tar respinge il ricorso di Meta

en.title: Fair compensation, the TAR rejects Meta's appeal
en.summary: Meta lost a case at the Lazio Administrative Court regarding fair compensation for news content. Publishers are calling for concrete implementation of the right to be paid when their news is used online.

stories.title: Esaote diventa cinese: Midea proprietaria al 100%

en.title: Esaote becomes Chinese: Midea is 100% owner
en.summary: Chinese group Midea has completed the acquisition of 100% of Esaote, an Italian medical imaging company headquartered in Genoa with operations in Florence.

stories.title: Giù la produzione industriale (-1,3%), frenata da moda e chimica

en.title: Industrial production down (-1.3%), slowed by fashion and chemicals
en.summary: Italy's industrial production declined 1.3% in August according to Istat data, with no annual variation, returning to levels from a year earlier.

stories.title: Data center, in Italia investimenti potenziali per 37 miliardi di euro

en.title: Data centers, potential investments of 37 billion euros in Italy
en.summary: Italy's data center sector could attract 37 billion euros in potential investments driven by artificial intelligence demand, though operators cite regulatory certainty as a key obstacle.

stories.title: Ansaldo energia incorpora Nucleare come business unit

en.title: Ansaldo Energia incorporates Nuclear as business unit
en.summary: Ansaldo Energia's board approved the merger of Ansaldo Nucleare through incorporation, creating a dedicated Nuclear business unit within the company.
